mapper.insert: INSERT INTO easybuy_refund (order_id, refund_no, amount, reason, pay_type, transaction_id, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{refundNo}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{payType}, #{transactionId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM easybuy_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
